summary: Iteration 75 - Onboarding Persistence & 'Meine Rechte' UI: All 13 backend tests passed, all frontend tests passed. POST /api/users/me/onboarding-complete requires auth (401 without), sets onboarding_completed_at ISO timestamp, persists in user document (verified via GET /api/auth/me). GET /api/user/permissions now includes capability_labels field with {label, category, description} for each capability in German. ProfilePage 'Meine Rechte' block shows 46 capabilities grouped by 9 categories (module, news, meetings, chat, documents, scheduling, surveys, admin, global). OnboardingTour correctly skips when user.onboarding_completed_at is set. Regression: Email preferences and unsubscribe endpoints still work.
critical_code_review_comments: BACKEND: routes/auth.py - POST /users/me/onboarding-complete (lines 161-171) correctly requires auth via get_current_user, sets onboarding_completed_at ISO timestamp, returns {onboarding_completed_at: <iso>}
BACKEND: routes/admin.py - GET /user/permissions (lines 146-156) correctly builds capability_labels dict from CAPABILITIES list, only includes caps that user has
BACKEND: dependencies.py - get_current_user returns full user document minus password_hash, so onboarding_completed_at flows to /api/auth/me automatically
FRONTEND: OnboardingTour.js - Correctly checks user.onboarding_completed_at before showing tour (line 33), calls api.post('/users/me/onboarding-complete') on finish (line 48)
FRONTEND: ProfilePage.js - 'Meine Rechte' block (lines 289-371) fetches /api/user/permissions, groups capabilities by category using CATEGORY_LABELS, displays German labels from capability_labels
FRONTEND: ProfilePage.js - All data-testid attributes present: my-permissions-block, my-permissions-toggle, my-permissions-list, cap-category-{cat}
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 75 tested Onboarding Persistence and 'Meine Rechte' UI. (3) ProfilePage 'Meine Rechte' block shows 46 capabilities grouped by 9 categories with German labels. (4) OnboardingTour correctly skips when user.onboarding_completed_at is set. (5) Regression: Email preferences (GET/PUT /users/me/email-preferences) and unsubscribe endpoints (GET/POST /unsubscribe/{token}, POST /unsubscribe/{token}/resubscribe) still work correctly.
